residue.text: - **The chiasmus — "the space is the wall."** Two eras' compiled results cross: the sign season proved *positivity is free without the zeros* (`positivity_free_obstruction_is_zeroRealization`); the inverse-spectral converse (de Branges) proves *the operator is free given the positivity* (multiplication on `B(E)`, once Hermite–Biehler membership — RH-equivalent — holds). They meet at the one object neither supplies: **the positive space on the zeros**. This is the residue's most compressed honest form. **Author's framing recorded — the koan: *space ⟺ zeros*** (the space is what realizes the zeros; the zeros are what the space lacks; each is the other's absence). Now the residue paper's §6 final compression (v1.1) and monograph §27.3 (v5.13).
